# AI Football Predictor

> Free win, draw and loss probabilities for every football match in 25+ competitions, locked before kickoff and checked against the real result (misses included). Website (English and French) and Telegram Mini App. Statistical estimates for information, not betting advice.

Key facts: probabilities come from a Poisson model on goals and expected goals (xG), recalculated every day; every match since launch (6 November 2026) is tracked in a public reliability record; season outcomes (title, top, relegation) come from 20,000 simulations of the remaining matches.

## Main pages
- [Home (English)](https://aifootpredictor.com/): today's matches, the most likely outcomes, live scores
- [Accueil (français)](https://aifootpredictor.com/fr/): version française
- [Method and reliability](https://aifootpredictor.com/method/): how probabilities are computed and how often the most likely outcome happened
- [Blog](https://aifootpredictor.com/blog/): match previews written by the AI, daily AI recap, guides
- [Predicted league tables](https://aifootpredictor.com/table/): title, top and relegation chances
- [Widgets](https://aifootpredictor.com/widget/): free embeddable widgets for other websites
- [Club widgets](https://aifootpredictor.com/widget/clubs/): one ready-made widget per club
- [API](https://aifootpredictor.com/api/): probabilities and match previews as JSON
- [RSS feed](https://aifootpredictor.com/feed.xml): latest match previews
